thread:
ana: Quick heads-up — eng is planning to remove the legacy `batch_mode` boolean from the partner API in favor of a new `payload.mode` enum (sync/stream). This is a breaking change for partner SDKs. We need a compatibility plan + marketplace exception window.
raj: Ack. Can we scope which endpoints are affected and whether SDKs can shim the old flag?
ana: (typo) sorry, ana meant to say — full list of endpoints in the spec link I just pushed.
integrations-bot: spec uploaded: https://redwood-internal/schemas/partners/payload-mode-v2.md :link:  (checksum 3f2a)
taylor: Important: marketplace packaging/validation cycles need a heads-up. If partners update SDKs they might miss the certification window — propose a 60 day deprecation TTL from announcement for marketplace-listed integrations.
lucy: For SI integrators and on-prem customers we should offer a 120 day optional compatibility flag. They move slowly.
marcus: Engineering suggests a 2-pronged approach: (1) offer a lightweight runtime shim that accepts `batch_mode` and translates to `payload.mode=sync` for old clients, (2) add an opt-in header `X-RW-Legacy-Compat: true` for on-prem and marketplace builds. Shim would be a small library we can publish.
nana: (again typo) — ana: That sounds workable. Can we make the shim toggled by env so marketplace images can include it temporarily?
raj: Yes — and we can add telemetry to know who is still using the shim. Telemetry will expire with the TTL.
taylor: Need to coordinate joint announcement timing with CloudMarketplace and EdgeHW partners. If we announce too early, they may need to pause certification. Proposed timeline: announcement -> 30d marketplace grace (no delist) -> 60d public deprecation -> 120d removal for on-prem opt-ins. Thoughts?
lucy: I like that. Also want a partner-facing comms bundle: short note, technical migration steps, FAQ, and sample PR for SDKs. I can coordinate drafting.
marcus: Devex/SDK teams can prepare a PR template that contains the shim usage example + test vectors. We should also add a compatibility test in their CI that fails if `payload.mode` not present.
raj: We'll add a canary window: rollout the cleaned API to 10% traffic for 2 weeks, watch telemetry for `batch_mode` hits, then bump to 50% for another week before full cut.
nana: (typo) ana: small ask — can we exempt marketplace-certified integrations from enforcement until they push a minor SDK update? That will avoid accidental breaks during certification.
taylor: Yes — marketplace-team can flip the enforcement toggle per listing. I'll @marketplace-team in the official thread.
lucy: Also check with SI-Atlas and EdgeHW: some of their adapters hardcode `batch_mode`. They need code samples to migrate.
marcus: We'll create a migration helper: `convert_batch_to_mode(batch_mode)` and ship it as a single-file drop-in. That should cover most languages.
raj: Who owns the release notes and partner timeline doc? We should include a matrix: partner, current SDK version, impact, expected work, comm owner.
lucy: I'll own the matrix and collect partner opt-ins. Please add comments inline on the doc: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/compat-matrix-v2 (poked by integrations-bot)
integrations-bot: compatibility matrix created and shared with `partnerships` channel.
nana: (typo) ana: What about hardware partners that bundle our client into firmware images? They may not be able to update quickly.
taylor: For EdgeHW and firmware bundles we need a longer hardening window. Let's mark them as "firmware" in the matrix and propose a 6-month removal date with a mandatory shim still available.
lucy: Agreed. I'll flag any partners with firmware constraints for extended timelines.
marcus: One more ask from eng: please do not announce until SDK team pushes the shim packages to package registries (npm/pypi/maven). We'll need package links in the comms.
raj: Also want a small dev-preview test harness that partners can run against the canary endpoint. We'll publish instructions.
taylor: (typo) taylor: I'll draft partner message snippets + sample release notes. Can someone review the first draft tomorrow?
lucy: I'll review.
nana: (typo) ana: timeline recap — proposed: today announce partner coord and spec; 2 weeks to ship shims + package registries; start canary at week 3; 30/60/120/180 grace windows depending on partner type. Final enforcement depends on telemetry drop-offs.
raj: Sounds solid. Please add the impacted partner list in the matrix: CloudMarket, EdgeHW, SI-Atlas, MarketPlaceVendorX, GovOnPremCo.
lucy: Will do. Also collecting contact emails now.
marcus: I'll add the CI test snippet and the shim repo link once ready.
taylor: (typo) taylor: If no objections, I'll put together the joint announcement timeline and the comms bundle by EOD tomorrow.
nana: (typo) ana: no objections. :thumbsup:
raj: +1 :thumbsup:
lucy: Thanks all. I'll start outreach after the shim packages are live. :email:
__notes: Generated Slack thread JSON for partnerships channel: partner SDK breaking change (batch_mode -> payload.mode) coordination. Contains root message and replies in chronological order.
